notes.title: Meet the winner of Gamescom Latam Big Festival!
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to share some amazing news with our players and the entire VR community: [i][b]Sugar Mess – Let’s Play Jolly Battle[/b][/i] has been awarded [b]Best XR/VR[/b] Game at the 13th edition of [i][url=https://latam.gamescom.global/en/big-festival-en/#finalists]Gamescom Latam BIG Festival[/url][/i]!

[b]A Milestone for JollyCo[/b]
This recognition is a huge milestone for us at [i]JollyCo[/i]. We put a lot of heart into developing Sugar Mess, and being selected as the winner among other outstanding XR/VR titles from around the world is something we’re incredibly proud of. It’s a rewarding moment that we share with all the players who believed in the game, gave it a try, and helped spread the word.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561601/792a58606a60a9b2efa98de1cf51639223049853.png[/img]

[b]Thanks to BIG Festival & Gamescom Latam[/b]
We would like to extend our sincere thanks to the [i]BIG Festival [/i]organizers and [i]Gamescom Latam[/i] for their ongoing commitment to indie games and virtual reality. Since 2012, the BIG Festival has been a platform where innovation and creativity shine, and it has grown even more influential with its new partnership under the Gamescom Latam umbrella. The festival highlights 100 standout games each year and gives developers a valuable opportunity to showcase their work to a global audience. To be not only nominated but selected as a winner means a lot to us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561601/3e025a0fe8b095248bf5f5f1c2b81ec37ea9f176.png[/img]

[b]Inside the Sugar Kingdom[/b]
[i]Sugar Mess – Let’s Play Jolly Battle[/i] is a vibrant, family-friendly VR arcade shooter available on Steam. In the game, players enter the Sugar Kingdom - a world full of sweets, surprises, and challenges - and take on the role of Sugar Prince, a brave hero on a mission to save a cherished friendship. To set things right, Sugar Prince must battle waves of mischievous enemies, face off against powerful bosses, solve tricky puzzles, and even tackle rhythm-based trials. With a mix of colorful visuals, engaging gameplay, and intuitive mechanics, each level offers a fresh experience designed to entertain players of different ages.
[olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561601/f554f1a88004a3c7f3fa822679bd913fd2dd03f8.gif[/img][/olist]
The game features a story-driven [b]Campaign Mode[/b], a challenging [b]Nightmare Mode[/b] for those seeking tougher battles. Whether you're shooting flying cakes or mighty bosses, the gameplay encourages quick reflexes, creativity, and a good sense of rhythm. We wanted to create something that families can enjoy together and that brings out the fun side of VR.

[b]Thanks to the Community[/b]
We’re also incredibly grateful for the feedback and engagement we've received from players across the VR community. Seeing the fun that people are having with Sugar Mess has kept us motivated every step of the way.

To all the players, creators, and partners who supported us - thank you. This award belongs to all of you as much as it does to us. We invite everyone to jump into [i]Sugar Mess – Let’s Play Jolly Battle[/i] on Steam, try the game and share your own gameplay moments with the community.

Here’s to more sweet adventures ahead!

The[i] JollyCo [/i]Team

notes.title: DevLog #7: Main Campaign Weapons
notes.content:
For a deeper dive into the game and shooting mechanics of our VR FPS, today we decided to compile a guide to the game’s arsenal. We included in it the information on all types of weapons that can be used in the main campaign and in the Arena Mode, which will appear along with the future update of the game.

[h2]Arcade Machine[/h2]

Players have the option to unlock various weapons using the Arcade Machine in Sugar Mess - Let’s Play Jolly Battle. The weapons can be acquired in any order using the coins earned by completing levels. The amount of accumulated coins depends on the player's performance. 

We used creative and imaginative terminology for in-game weapons to maintain an age-appropriate and non-violent gaming experience.

[h2]Main Campaign Weapons[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561601/dd5b4c284123009b1dfed18007d8d771ea808c29.png[/img]
The main campaign features three types of guns:

[b]Ice Cream Gun[/b] - is a semiautomatic handgun that fires with ice cream one round every time the trigger is pulled. Long range, medium damage. 
[list]
[*] Pros: speed and mobility. Issued free of charge at the start of the game. 
[/list]
[b]Fanged Ice Cream Gun[/b] - This skin will be available after the player completes all the campaign levels on 2 difficulties.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561601/8d600ac8ed6c5b777f49d6dc71b6414c93844646.gif[/img]

[b]Blender Gun[/b] - is a carabin-type gun that fires continuously when the trigger is held down. It can be used one-handed (but suffers heavy recoil that way). Stable shooting requires grabbing it with both hands. You can fire it in full auto mode by holding the trigger button. The projectiles fly using a ballistic trajectory, each dealing minor damage. 
[list]
[*] Pros: large magazine, effective against crowds of enemies. 
[/list]
[b]Fanged Blender Gun[/b] - This skin will be available after the player completes all the campaign levels on 2 difficulties.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561601/04cad743efd9105fdea6e4f72293fdc8d4a30ec9.gif[/img]

[b]Toaster Gun[/b] - is a hybrid gun that shoots a spread of several pellets that are actually chocolate crumbs. It can be used both two-handed and one-handed (but suffers increased cooldown that way). Fires pellets in a cone. 
[list]
[*] Pros: heavy damage, deals damage with each individual pellet. Effective against bosses.
[/list]
[b]Fanged Toaster Gun[/b] - this skin will be available after the player completes all the campaign levels on 2 difficulties.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561601/b50df6b3fd303f895fc85ac8421a1d2a1e899c00.gif[/img]

[b]Killing enemies earns weapon XP.[/b] The XP amount depends on the type of enemy. Reaching a set amount of XP takes the weapon to a new level. The weapons have three potential levels / upgrades. Each weapon level increases its damage, rate of fire, and magazine capacity. 

We've covered the basics of Sugar Mess - Let’s Play Jolly Battle's weaponry, offering insights into the game's diverse arsenal. Stay tuned for Part II, where we'll unveil more guns and skins for the Arena multiplayer co-op mode, enhancing your gaming experience!

notes.title: DevLog #5: Enemies in Sugar Kingdom
notes.content:
Hey! Today we’d like to share with you some new insights about the upcoming Chapter II of the VR game Sugar Mess - Let’s Play Jolly Battle. We will dedicate this DevLog to new enemies in the game.

The enemies take the form of various cakes, each with different shapes and colors in the Chapter I of Sugar Mess - Let’s Play Jolly Battle. They are relentlessly attacking the main hero throughout the gameplay. These cake mobs hurl candies and snowballs, posing a threat to the Prince, the player character, and diminishing their health as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561601/fb03b861a985c3d7e132cab7e0e1adfe15b59d9d.png[/img]

The cake mobs in the game follow consistent patterns - they shoot and fly towards the main character, the player. There are different types of cake mobs:
[list]
[*] Round cake, doughnut, flies and shoots at the player.
[*] Pink cake flies and shoots at the player
[*] Violet cake runs on the ground, flies, and shoots at the player
[*] Purple cake, the longest one, stays on the ground and shoots, appearing and hiding from different sides.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561601/2e4341063709c4852d53dd5a5ef21efc598d6ec4.png[/img]

However, not all mobs attack the player - there are also helpers. Round flying cakes are ready to come to the rescue in difficult times. They take out a first aid kit from their backpack, helping the prince heal himself.

The cake mobs feature fresh skins on the challenging 10 levels of the Chapter II, offering players a completely new gaming experience. In addition, the enemies become even stronger and more agile.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561601/a0de59fdeb2342ef9bb6e8daaa138ac93d5ecde6.gif[/img]

Work on the update continues, follow our news to stay updated! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Dev Log #4 - New Levels
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

In this post for our DevLog, we want to reveal the secret of the development of “Sugar Mess - Let’s Play Jolly Battle. Chapter II”. These are 10 completely new game levels for players who will cope with the first 10 levels of Chapter I. So, we will tell you about new level concepts.

[b]Chapter II: The plot and setting[/b]

The Sugar Kingdom is suddenly attacked by cakes. Sugar Prince, armed with an arsenal of sweet weapons, repels the attacks of opponents. He goes on a journey through the Kingdom to find out who dared to attack him?

Starting in Chapter I, a player gets into a stylized hub, that is actually a Prince’s room. In order to start the game, the player learns a lot of interesting things from an interactive pop-up book that is placed in the center of the hub. Every book spread unveils the Prince’s story. The book actually gives to the player a short version of the plot and cutscenes themselves. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561601/836587df9ecd08a20cf66fc66d4f8814a02fd1de.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561601/c527a757536eff4418d209beb0a4f01698bfc9bb.png[/img]

After successfully completing the levels of Chapter I, players will unlock the challenging mode of Chapter II with its 10 new levels. To access this mode, players interact with a lever in the main hub area, triggering a transition to a completely new landscape. This new land presents players 10 fresh challenges and obstacles, effectively replacing the old map with an entirely new one.

The following levels introduce a variety of challenges, each offering a unique experience. Each level presents distinct obstacles, ensuring a diverse and engaging gameplay journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561601/682ccda0231711ab05cceb664ad917e01988185e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561601/f43ccc5f873285b40d1cdfe5ca15d4d38c4086d5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561601/be3e096a202353ab33d4ee445d6557ab7652ccd1.png[/img]

After successfully completing the entire challenging mode (Chapter II), players are rewarded with exclusive items: three skins for default guns and four additional guns. 

These rewards can be used in the Arena mode - the extra level, in co-op mode, enhancing the player's arsenal and customization options.

Stay tuned for more news!

notes.title: DevLog #3. Arena - Multiplayer Mode
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 
We keep working on our great update for Sugar Mess - Let’s Play Jolly Battle! In this blog we will share intermediate results for Multiplayer: Arena Single Player and Co-Op mode.

[b]Arena[/b]

The classic solo or multiplayer modes are available on the Arena Mode. The primary objective is to defend the Sweet land diligently, fending off opponents’ attacks. Each wave of opponents presents a different challenge, with the difficulty escalating as the player successfully repels more waves. Repelling a certain number of wave attacks entitles the player to valuable rewards.

Here is how we worked on the UI for this mode:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561601/4856bf0a63781ecbacb530e4767c16d4045e7ff4.png[/img]

The arena zone has several key elements:

[b]Active Zone: [/b]

Positioned at the center of the arena, this area features teleportation spots for movement, areas for fortifications, and stations for weapon recharging. The active zone remains constant throughout the gameplay.

[b]Chunks: [/b]

These are designated land areas encircling the active zone, from which cake mobs launch their attacks. Chunks constantly shift, and each one features different terrain, biome, and object arrangements, adding to the game's dynamic nature.

Here is a work-in-progress look of chunks:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561601/78957bbc56fe1be1913a8fd1458cb475dcf082ce.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561601/517b57b7f50415b9f4465b45c9adb59ee8e4a7d8.png[/img]

[b]Single-player mode[/b]

In the game, a player is placed in the center of the Arena, the main play area. Their objective is to safeguard the boundaries of their zone from cake attacks.

[b]Co-op mode[/b]

In the co-op mode, players have the option to join existing rooms hosted by others or create their own rooms and invite fellow players.

In co-op mode, progressing through the Arena remains similar to solo play, with one key difference: all cake mobs get stronger, including increased damage and HP percentage. In solo play, cake mobs spawn from 2 sides, whereas in multiplayer mode, they are flying from 4 sides, intensifying the challenge for players in cooperative gameplay.

Stay tuned for more updates! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Devlog #2. Lore, mechanics & levels
notes.content:
VR titles are those types of games that provide players with maximum immersion in the process. Sugar Mess - Let’s Play Jolly Battle can give you this and even more.

Our team had an idea to create a fun arcade FPS, a game that will unite, connect and bring interest in the entire family, from kids to grandpas. And this is exactly what they achieved!

	The Sugar Mess begins in a Sugar Kingdom, where an ambitious Sugar Prince, shaped like a cookie, wants to build the best Kingdom ever seen. To do so, he uses a robot, because let’s be serious everyone wants a robot helper! Robbie, the robot helper, is of great use and both these friends are doing the best job ever. But as mentioned before ambition grows and Robbie needed an update, so the Prince builds a better robot named Robbo, and this is exactly where everything goes crazy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561601/7497c96fd7a1980785c2bcfb0743c7de813c0521.jpg[/img]

	Once you get your device on and connect to the game you will be transported into a hub like you’ve never seen before. The prince’s room, a place where you will make choices, relax and interact with the one and only interactive book with the entire story. Another amazing and fun thing is this inception, literally a game in the game. Bring back the memories, and play on an Arcade Machine, or teach your kids this old school fun stuff. 

You explored the room, just being chill and calm, opened the book, it announced about the 1 level that you are about to start, and ohh yeah the fun part begins, you are now in the Sugar Kingdom wandering around and just as you blink, there is an Ice-cream gun in your hand, ice-cream ammo on your left side and your enemies, the sweetest cookies are flying towards you, and you have to defend yourself, you are the Hero aren’t you? Refill and hit everything that flies, it’s your chance to prove that you are the best. 

It’s impossible not to mention the art and the drawing which is absolutely beautiful and unique, as the JollyCo team developed the style and features deriving from the Jolly Battle franchise and perfecting it to the point where it looks juicy and tasty and absolutely fun! 

Diving into the game, completing levels you will encounter a variety of activities and levels that will keep you busy for hours.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561601/4d463f489c059bee27559dfb2d4fa540530dfafc.png[/img]

You are a roller coaster lover, yeah sure no problem bud, we got you, take a ride on the wheel cart through the kingdom, or maybe you are a music fan or musically VR games, well you are in the best place… I mean level. Get your hammers and beat the rhythm out of this game! And when you want to tickle the brain, a puzzle level is just there waiting to be solved so you can run forward into saving the Kingdom from these awful mobs.  

Another unique thing in this game is bosses. Yes, you are reading it just right, you won’t find robot bosses in other arcade first person shooters!  This gives the twist and the challenge that you are thriving for! Just a small spoiler, the final boss is Robbie, the first helper that looks for revenge and actually attacks the Kingdom, for being forgotten. 
This definitely sounds like a sad story, it’s a lost friendship and constant fight to save the dearest and closest friends and to restore the beautiful Kingdom that once was, but three is always a but, all fairy tales have a happy ending, and you will find out this one only when you get to the end of it. 

Now as you know the story,  found out about the levels, put all the puzzles together and you are ready to be the hero of the Sugar Kingdom. This can easily be called a game that has everything and more. The music and soundtrack is unique and accompany you in this journey, because it was specifically written for Sugar Mess. The constant updates on skins and collectibles are also a fun feature that is there to support your warrior spirit and keep up with the sweet battle. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561601/aae9bbef16ca1d6b934706641864adac3373110f.png[/img]

Sugar Mess - Let’s play Jolly Battle is worth every penny that you are about to spend, you will get amazing visuals and sounds, a variety of levels with different activities that will fit every VR player, the complexity of levels, constant updates, skins and a ton of collectibles, different guns and amos (ice cream, waffles even a freaking blender) and new content is just a click away. 
The game devs at managed to create something that is contradictory, a hero shooter and sweets all over,  and it goes perfect just like peanut butter and jelly. A game that fits in every age category, that is competitive and fun, a game that meets every VR gamer criteria, a game that is for the entire family and will satisfy all the sweet teeth in the world.

notes.title: TGS 2023: Summary and Impressions
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

As you already know Sugar Mess - Let’s Play Jolly Battle took part in one of the biggest gaming events and to be more specific it was the Tokyo Game Show 2023! This year, 243,248 people visited the exhibition over 4 days.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561601/3ee87ad186da04908da7ff05a730290151ce9599.jpg[/img]

Our team flew to Japan and presented our arcade first person shooter for the whole family. It was a blast! 
We’ve met a lot of fun and creative people, made contacts with some industry giants, shared our work and collected feedback right away. It was an honor to share, talk and debate features in the gaming industry with professionals, game lovers, developers and fans.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561601/c2c8073b42224a6f082d2b399305b41a22239fa8.jpg[/img]

And here are the key moments that the gamers noticed during these awesome days, so we’d like to share with you a short feedback review:

[b]First-time VR Gaming Experience:[/b] gamers who were playing VR for the first time, praised the clarity and simplicity of the controls, as well as the clarity of actions they had to do.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561601/cd98b258bb1d92b1eb69342fc275abef4c6b4b5d.jpg[/img]

[b]Presentation of information and narrative:[/b] players praised the storytelling in the book and way information was conveyed through tips in tutorial, and loading screen.

[b]Book and Plot:[/b] The book itself was praised as a very original way of presenting cutscenes. According to the players, it’s fun not just to look at the pictures, but to interact with the book as a game element. The plot itself seemed interesting, the players liked the characters calling them cool, especially the robots. They noted funny and intriguing moments, the characters.

[b]Gameplay on the first level:[/b] According to feedback from players, behind the colorful gameplay lies not just a game for minors, but a shooter that can also interest adults. Thus, experienced gamers passed the level from the first try, and players with less experience needed more time to succeed, but they were no less delighted with the process. 

[b]Other levels:[/b] Some players completed the game without interruption, progressing well through the levels. The variety of gameplay mechanics and their execution was a pleasant surprise for them. 

[b]Gameplay: [/b]Players highly appreciated the quality of gameplay and its engaging plot. We’ve got feedback and suggestions from experienced players aimed at improving the gameplay, such as the height difference on rail levels. The bosses seemed complex and thoughtful. People liked also rhythm levels and puzzles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561601/01cb45fb55e01bff2bfe72c7f768bc132f451f07.gif[/img]

We're grateful for TGS for hosting the show and we'd be happy to come back next year! :)

notes.title: Tokyo Game Show 2023 Showcase
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Sugar Mess - Let’s Play Jolly Battle took part in the Tokyo Game Show 2023! Our team attended this international event, where we showcased our VR fun first-person shooter! We cannot even express how proud we are about all of the members of our team, who made such an amazing job.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561601/384ee97a2649916b667ccbe3b751e0adcd6aa30b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561601/afabbae8b8cf8201e106e6a80507b33dc36e3d63.png[/img]
We were excited to meet so many interesting people from the gaming industry as well as players, who left us priceless feedback right on the spot. Each of them shared their unique opinions and suggestions. And we are glad they spent their time to test Sugar Mess - Let’s Play Jolly Battle and, believe us, they were satisfied with it! We saw a lot of emotions, laughter, amazements and fun.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561601/4b2d9bffbcea32eeac22618bcddeb0ca9c484307.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561601/3306e5f5bab178cd5084049d224ae3443add5670.png[/img]
It was an incredible feeling to participate in this international event and be among the giants of the gaming world! Check out photos from the scene.

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Sugar Mess - Let’s play Jolly Battle is coming to Steam!
notes.content:
[b]This is perfect news for the Steam VR players and Steam community! We are excited and ready to present you VR first-person shooter Sugar Mess - Let’s play Jolly Battle page on Steam. 
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561601/114587cc5b340d0c2bf06b2ad63749db968df2c2.jpg[/img]

On this page we will share with you the freshest out of the oven updates and features of our VR game, like levels, awesome weapons and skins, fascinating stories with our characters and non the less the variety of the mechanics that will keep you full of adrenaline for hours!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561601/6d8c2e3f1acf4fe31a63448653a0a25608aba52d.gif[/img]
 
You don’t want to miss a thing in this sweet-crazy arcade first person shooter. Immerse in the Sugar Kingdom and explore every corner, blast enemies, play some drums, solve some puzzles and take a ride throughout the Kingdom.
